skill.summary: Assist with AOSP builds, HAL analysis, Framework edits, ROM customization, and SDK/NDK issues using isolated environments and detailed reports.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Android Dev Agent Skill.

- Supports AOSP 编译、HAL 分析、Framework 修改、ROM 定制等任务
- 提供独立环境隔离、防污染主目录
- 日志记录所有编译/分析命令，输出标准报告
- 明确区分 Android 版本，遇阻时补充 workaround
- 详细规范常用流程、任务触发条件和输出响应内容
